Swissbit is a German storage and security manufacturer with a Berlin based authentication line. Their iShield Key family covers a range of FIDO2 keys, including a MIFARE variant for dual use as a physical access badge and a FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validated model for high assurance customers. Swissbit also manufactures keys for [REINER SCT](../reiner-sct/) and is the supplier for the RSA branded iShield Key 2.
